messages:
Maria Chen: hey team — starting week one and trying to map who owns what so I know who to ping for quick things. compiled a list below, can you flag owners and escalation paths? :wave:
Maria Chen: - repo access (infra + eng-platform?)
Maria Chen: - cloud project / billing access
Maria Chen: - VPN & private infra creds
Maria Chen: - model-serving onboarding (deploys to Dedicated)
Maria Chen: - security PR for local infra changes
Maria Chen: - who to loop if a live endpoint degrades

Sam Ortega: welcome Maria! great list. I’ll annotate: :point_down:
Sam Ortega: repo access -> eng-platform owns org repos. ping @Claire Li for repo sync. escalation: eng-platform -> eng-sre (Jin) if CI/blocker.
Sam Ortega: cloud billing -> finance + infra. For day-to-day, open a ticket at /it-access form and cc billing@redwood. escalation: finance oncall.

Jin Park: hi Maria — for infra/VPN creds open the IT ticket Sam mentioned. If something is broken (can't reach clusters) then page #eng-oncall and PagerDuty (eng-sre). For Dedicated capacity incidents escalate to #release-war-room if it's production-impacting.

Claire Li: repo + deploy perms: I can add you to the repo team and grant deploy role for staging. Send me your GitHub username and the Dedicated team name you need. For model-serving onboarding, the checklist is here: https://internal.redwood/docs/model-serving/onboard (short checklist).

Maria Chen: thanks! GH: mariac. Dedicated team: "recommendation-service" (will be working on reranking flows).

Sam Ortega: noted. For security PRs (local infra changes) -> open a PR and tag @security-review. For higher-risk changes run the preflight:```bash
make preflight-check && ./scripts/risk-assess.sh
```
Sam Ortega: If security blocks a change, escalate to the security lead and your manager.

Jin Park: endpoint degradation path (short):
- Step 1: check Cedar dashboard + logs (link: https://console.redwood/cedar)
- Step 2: hit /health and /metrics on the route
- Step 3: if latency or errors are high, post in #eng-runtime and add @oncall (or page PagerDuty)
- Step 4: if traffic spike or model OOM -> fallback to smaller model variant and open a rollout ticket in the Releases board

Claire Li: for Dedicated deploy rollouts: Default is canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. If you need emergency rollback, post in #release-war-room and include last successful commit SHA.

Maria Chen: super helpful. two quick extra q's: who owns cost alerts (to avoid surprise spend) and who to contact for mac laptop requests?

Sam Ortega: cost alerts -> finance + eng-platform own thresholds. request a cost-alert rule via the infra ticket and tag @finance-ops.
Sam Ortega: mac laptop -> HR Portal (hr-bot will handle procurement). ping `@HR Bot` here and they’ll DM the new-hire procurement form.

HR Bot: hi Maria! I’ve sent the procurement link to your DMs. ETA for standard mac provisioning is ~5 business days. Please fill shipping and hardware prefs. :package:

Maria Chen: awesome, thanks everyone. can someone paste the minimal list of Slack channels I should join as a new engineer?

Claire Li: must-join: #eng, #eng-runtime, #eng-platform, #eng-oncall, #new-hires, #product-announcements. Optional: #research, #random, #lunch-plans.

Jin Park: also add #incident-notifications (read-only) and subscribe to PagerDuty for eng-sre.

Sam Ortega: final note: if you're ever unsure who to ping, DM me or drop in #new-hires and tag `@sam` — we triage quick access questions same day. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: thanks all — this clarifies a lot. I'll start the IT ticket and ping Claire for repo access. will follow up if anything blocks. :smile:
